description: This file provides utility functions and structures for statistical testing of distributions, including moments calculation, Z-score computation, and beta/incomplete beta functions, primarily for testing purposes within the Abseil library.

classes.name: DistributionMoments
classes.description: A structure holding statistical moments: count, mean, variance, skewness, and kurtosis.

methods.name: ComputeDistributionMoments
methods.description: Calculates the first four moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) of a dataset.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the DistributionMoments to an output stream.

methods.name: ZScore
methods.description: Calculates the Z-score for a dataset given expected mean and distribution moments.

methods.name: RequiredSuccessProbability
methods.description: Calculates the success probability needed per trial to keep the overall failure probability below a threshold.

methods.name: MaxErrorTolerance
methods.description: Determines the maximum tolerable error distance from the mean for Z-tests.

methods.name: beta
methods.description: Calculates the Beta function for parameters p and q.

methods.name: InverseNormalSurvival
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the normal survival function.

methods.name: Near
methods.description: Checks if actual value is near expected within a given bound.

methods.name: BetaIncomplete
methods.description: Computes the incomplete regularized beta function.

methods.name: BetaIncompleteInv
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the incomplete regularized beta function.
